narratives.Problem: After Module 3, learners need to classify persisted work artifacts and repair generated views through their authoritative sources.
narratives.Change: Author Modules 4 and 5, explained solutions, a small fictional no-remote projection lab, focused validation, and the connecting navigation and references.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Keep the existing combined curriculum scope as one sequential implementation unit. Module 4 uses a command-free classification exercise. Module 5 uses the released codebase MAP renderer and freshness verifier, plus independent existence/content evidence and guarded reset/archive paths. Integrate both lessons and validate the whole unit before local handoff.
narratives.Authorization: David requested: pull the latest master and proceed to implement the next two modules once the lifecycle closeout running in the other session is complete. The dependency was verified complete and master was fast-forwarded to 620f3c92d940e7fc2e3459f518a3b33a48534737 before implementation. This records the explicit implementation request, not a separate yes response or remote-delivery approval.
narratives.Scope: Modules 4-5 only, with shared navigation, source evidence, local cost context, and tests needed for those modules. Later modules, live deployment, upstream changes, external publication, push, PR, and merge are not part of this local handoff.
narratives.RiskAndProof: Per-verb help may execute commands in 0.112.0, and missing MAP is allowed by freshness. Probe in disposable repositories, assert file existence and content independently, and retain observed failures before recovery. New lab platform claims are limited to executed macOS/zsh evidence.
narratives.Stops: Success: both active-scope acceptance clauses and local checks pass. Failure: at most five fix iterations or three identical failures without progress; at most three review passes. Scope remains active until separately authorized delivery and lifecycle closeout.
narratives.LocalResult: Both modules and solutions are authored. The disposable lab's two stale states and passing recovery were reproduced with the exact 0.112.0 local graph on macOS/zsh. The 46-test suite and explicit 90% coverage thresholds pass. Detailed proof and framework advisory limits are in references/SOURCE-NOTES.md. No push, PR, merge, deployment, or publication occurred.
narratives.PortabilityAuthorization: After the Windows report at 41e5065, David was asked whether to implement the portability fixes and regression tests on the existing PR, then prepare the Windows retest. He answered: yes implement portability fixes. He also requested revalidation instructions for the Windows machine agent. This affirmative extends the existing change to the reported CRLF and executable-identity defects and regression coverage, not merge or lifecycle closeout.
narratives.PortabilityVerification: Reproduce the reported failures before edits. Preserve all semantic assertions when normalizing CRLF input; compare positive LF/CRLF and negative-content fixtures. Accept only the known npm Windows shim program for the exact local Directive target, with tampered-program/target/path negatives. Do not convert unavailable symlink capability into passing safety coverage. Native Windows completion remains pending external replay.
narratives.PortabilityLocalResult: Historical c8b27e3 result: the three content verifiers and 44 non-deleting tests passed locally with zero skips. The separate 28-test fixture/launcher coverage run passed explicit 90% thresholds: 96.60% lines, 95.60% branches, 100% functions across the two Lab 5 helper files. Independent code review found no actionable findings. The configured aggregate task deft:check passed, including the literal conformance command, with inherited scope/CI-composition advisories. The unchanged 32-test content-contract suite was not rerun in that follow-up because its temporary-fixture deletion route had not been selected. The subsequent HandoffRecoveryResult supersedes that rerun limitation. No safety assertion, cleanup behavior, or gate was weakened. This batch is for remote Windows revalidation, not a native Windows support or merge-ready claim.
narratives.HandoffRecoveryAuthorization: After a Windows launch-gate report showed no tests ran because the ignored framework payload was absent and bootstrap was prohibited, David approved correcting the handoff: yes, we need the windows validations instructions to be correct and actionable. The selected route explicitly permits bounded exact-commit selection, pinned core-only payload recovery, and normal cleanup of only newly created full-suite contract fixtures. Preserve existing deposits, attempts, evidence, and tracked course state; no merge or lifecycle closeout is authorized.
narratives.ArchiveFollowupAuthorization: The Windows report at 373389e confirms the bootstrap, CRLF, and real npm-launcher fixes, but archive fails while running inside the attempt. David answered yes to implementing and pushing an explicit guarded archive target that allows the caller and helper to run outside the directory being moved, with matching tests and a new Windows handoff stating symlink-test prerequisites. This continues the same Modules 4-5 scope and existing PR. Use recoverable rename for only newly created test attempts, retain old attempts/evidence, and keep normal current-run contract-test cleanup unchanged. Do not change Windows host settings, skip symlink assertions, merge, or close the lifecycle.
narratives.HandoffRecoveryResult: The complete 87-test local suite passes with zero failures or skips. Explicit 90% thresholds pass across the Lab 5 helpers, Modules 4-5 verifier, and recovery helper: 98.26% lines, 96.49% branches, 100% functions. Recovery-helper-specific coverage is 100% lines, 97.87% branches, 100% functions. A clean local clone restored 412 payload files from the public 419-file 0.112.0 headless manifest; Git remained clean and doctor exited 0 with all four formerly failing integrity checks passing. All seven PowerShell blocks parse, and the exact package-graph probe executes through PowerShell against the local pinned installation. Independent handoff review found no actionable blockers. These are local macOS checks, not native Windows completion or learner-ready evidence.
narratives.ArchiveFollowupResult: All 92 local tests pass with zero failures or skips. Explicit 90% thresholds pass across the two Lab 5 helpers, Modules 4-5 verifier, and recovery helper: 99.49% lines, 97.00% branches, 100% functions. All nine PowerShell blocks parse; the literal symlink probe and revised archive block execute through PowerShell on macOS. Native verification of this archive fix is pending a new exact-commit replay; Windows remains a candidate. No host setting, safety assertion, or gate was weakened.
narratives.LineEndingAuthorization: David answered yes, but can windows even to symlinks? to the explicit proposal to implement and push deterministic fixture line endings, add regression coverage, and update the Windows handoff. This is the same Modules 4-5 follow-up, not a new story or merge request. First reproduce the plain Git CRLF failure in new disposable fixtures, then fix source/index normalization and retain the exact whitespace gate with real-whitespace negative coverage. Run normal current-run contract-test cleanup and recoverably archive only newly created guarded lab attempts as previously selected; preserve all earlier attempts and the unrelated generation-file change. Verify and push the same PR branch before producing an exact-SHA handoff. Native Windows completion stays pending external replay and symlink capability.
narratives.LineEndingResult: The native CRLF failure was reproduced before product edits. All 101 local tests pass with zero failures/skips; explicit 90% thresholds pass at 99.49% lines, 97.01% branches, 100% functions across the included helpers/verifier. Eight LF/CRLF course, Git autocrlf, and edit combinations now pass plain git diff --check with a 1/1 purpose diff; genuine trailing spaces/tabs still fail in every combination. Attribute tamper/override and symlink guards remain enforced. A fresh complete macOS/zsh real 0.112.0 replay passed both stale/recovery pairs, all five final checks, nine-file checkpoint, fresh reset, and both preserved archives. A separate installed attempt executed the literal PowerShell CRLF edit block on macOS: no BOM, 1/1 diff, expected stale=1, recovery/final checks/archive=0. All ten PowerShell fences parse. Independent mechanics review found no actionable issues. Native e881f0 confirms archive success but leaves symlink capability and uninterrupted candidate replay incomplete; the new EOL behavior still requires an exact published-commit native run. No host configuration, whitespace check, assertion, or gate was weakened.
narratives.FinalizationDisposition: David requested: this does not seem to be improving despite multiple rounds of fixes. continue finalizing implemntation of the modules and move on. Finalize the existing Modules 4-5 implementation and PR with the verified macOS/zsh support boundary. Record the final 324b5f7 native report honestly: EOL 9/9 and archive contracts pass, full suite 97/101 with four symlink setup capability failures, candidate MODULE_NOT_FOUND from course cwd before the CRLF edit, downstream real-lab steps not run. Pause further Windows repair/retest work and retain its handoff as historical context; do not change runtime code, tests, gates, host posture, or old evidence. Existing merge and lifecycle authorization boundaries remain. The next proposed curriculum scope is Modules 6-8, dependent on delivered Modules 4-5; this finalization does not silently activate it.
